help.short: The name of the storage account within the specified resource group. Storage account names must be between 3 and 24 characters in length and use numbers and lower-case letters only.

description: List the object replication policies associated with the storage account.

operations.description: List the object replication policies associated with the storage account.

params.description: The name of the storage account within the specified resource group. Storage account names must be between 3 and 24 characters in length and use numbers and lower-case letters only.
params.name: accountName

params.description: The name of the resource group within the user's subscription. The name is case insensitive.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The ID of the target subscription.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: The replication policy between two storage accounts.
Fully qualified resource ID for the resource. Ex - /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}
props.name: id

props.description: Returns the Storage Account Object Replication Policy.
props.name: properties

props.description: Required. Destination account name. It should be full resource id if allowCrossTenantReplication set to false.
props.name: destinationAccount

props.description: Indicates when the policy is enabled on the source account.
props.name: enabledTime

props.description: Optional. The object replication policy metrics feature options.
props.name: metrics

props.description: Indicates whether object replication metrics feature is enabled for the policy.
props.name: enabled

props.description: A unique id for object replication policy.
props.name: policyId

props.description: The storage account object replication rules.
Optional. An object that defines the filter set.
props.name: filters

props.description: Blobs created after the time will be replicated to the destination. It must be in datetime format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'. Example: 2020-02-19T16:05:00Z
props.name: minCreationTime

props.description: Optional. Filters the results to replicate only blobs whose names begin with the specified prefix.
props.name: prefixMatch

props.description: Rule Id is auto-generated for each new rule on destination account. It is required for put policy on source account.
props.name: ruleId
rules
